system.description:
At the beginning of each session, roll your Resonance Dice and place them on your character sheet.

The number of Resonance Dice you roll depends on your Tier:

Tier

Resonance Dice

1

3d6

2

4d6

3

5d6

4

6d6

Each die may only be spent once.

You may spend a Resonance Die to:

  • Add its value to an Attack Roll.

  • Add its value to a Damage Roll.

  • Spend 1 Hope to clear 1 Hit Point on a creature within Close range.
Spend 3 Hope to recover one spent Resonance Die.
Mystics manipulate an unknown universal force known as the "Resonance". They can use the Resonance to buff their attacks or heal their allies.
You have advantage to Agility rolls to move in Zero-G. Also, Once per Session, you can survive unprotected in vacuum for a limited time, you can perform 5 actions.

VeCXHu0L8nmK611g.name: Action in the vaccum of space

system.description: Once per Scene, always know the direction of open space, your bonded vessel, or your last visited station.
You have Advantage on rolls to pilot spacecraft, maneuver in zero gravity, or maintain your balance in unusual gravity.

Whenever you spend a Resonance Die to hit or damage an adversary, target an ally within Close range of you. That ally may choose to:

  • Clear 1 Armor Slot.

  • Clear 1 Stress.

  • Gain 1 Hope.

items.name: I'm one with the Resonance and the Resonance is with me

system.description: Whenever you spend a Resonance Die, remove 1 Fear from the GM's Fear Pool.

Whenever you spend a Resonance Die you may mark a number of Hit Points equal to the Resonance Die and split amongst any number willing creature within Far range to clear an equal number of Hit Points on other willing creatures within Close range.

You can choose yourself in place of either creature.
A squid-like species naturally evolved to survive the void and hostile environments between the stars.
Play the Lifebinder if you want to support your allies through your attacks, keep your companions in the fight, and transform the Resonance into hope and resilience.

Being part of a spaceborne community means you were raised aboard spacecraft, orbital stations, or deep-space habitats rather than on the surface of a planet. You instinctively understand the rhythms of life in confined environments, from long voyages between the stars to emergency decompressions and zero-gravity maintenance. To a spaceborne person, an airlock feels as familiar as a front door.

Spaceborne are often adaptable, daring, disciplined, practical, resilient, and curious.

Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Far range. On a success, the target takes d6+1 magic damage using your Proficiency and the next time the target deals damage to an ally, it is reduced by half. If you succeed with Fear, the target instead takes d10+1 magic damage using your Proficiency.
Once per rest, after an ally attempts an action roll but before the consequences take place, you can offer assistance or words of support. When you do, your ally can reroll their dice.
